text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Look, Mr. C.B. and
Maruzensky are talking together!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm positive they're discussing some
extremely high-level racing techniques!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived to eat lunch, there were two students drawing a lot of attention.
As I watched them absentmindedly—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, hey, hey, yoo-hoo!
Could you come over here for a sec?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I have a few questions.
Do you mind hearing me out?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. has a serious look on her face.
Could she have a difficult question about the race?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I want to give a sharp, confident answer like a proper trainer should, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: How can I get better at cooking, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I've been giving CB-chan advice about living on her own, you see.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm a bit worried about you.
I'd like it if you took just a little more care of your health.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You live on your own too, right, Trainer?
Give this girl some super-fab advice~

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Well, I'm pretty careless!
I lead quite the laughable bachelor life, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
See, cooking is such a chore.
I always end up making easy stuff like fried rice.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you can't do that, okay?
Our bodies are our greatest assets."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I got to see an unexpected side of Mr. C.B.
However, as much as I wanted to offer some advice...
choice_data_list: I'm not really one to talk, either...
Well, I'm not really one to talk either...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?
choice_data_list: I always let laundry and stuff pile up...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I know!
choice_data_list: I always put off cleaning and stuff anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Totally~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha~...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I took the easy way out
and cooked a huge batch of curry ahead of time!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...When you let your laundry pile up too much,
the large washing machines in the dorm washroom are very handy.
You can wash a lot in one go.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Also, never leave curry at room temperature.
Once it cools down, refrigerate or freeze it immediately.
It actually spoils quite easily.
choice_data_list: As expected, you really know your stuff!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Mmm, pretty much♪

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man!
Seriously, living on my own made me realize
just how grateful I am for my parents!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Having someone cook three meals a day for you...
I realized just how unbelievably grateful
I should have been for that.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, someone was asking you about cooking.
Come to think of it, someone was asking you about cooking.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, come to think of it, that was the case, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oho, did you get an idea?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I got a clear sense of both her rough edges and her free spirit
from our conversation just now.
If I were to give someone like her advice—
choice_data_list: Rough-and-ready cooking is just like you, too.
Rough-and-ready cooking is just like you, too.
Let's try making some freeform creative cuisine!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I got a clear sense of both her rough edges and her free spirit
from our conversation just now.
If I were to give someone like her advice—
choice_data_list: Rough-and-ready cooking is just like you, too.
Rough-and-ready cooking is just like you, too.
Let's try making some freeform creative cuisine!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haha, you sure know how to make someone happy.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm Mr. C.B.
Fussing over little things and not having fun defeats the whole point!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true.
Having fun while cooking is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
As thanks, would the two of you like to join me for dinner?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While Mr. C.B.'s cooking method was certainly rough,
the dish turned out to be delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Freedom! That has a nice ring to it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
I've tried doing that with Italian food before, but it's super duper hard, you know? Are you sure you're okay~?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if I'll do well.
Still, taking on challenges suits my nature.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying freedom.
Yeah, that sounds super exciting!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Mr. C.B.
whipped up a variety of original dishes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Super-Sweet Mapo Tofu," "Ramen-Flavored Pizza,"
"Deep-Fried Fruit"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It certainly might not have tasted good,
but seeing her cook with such joy somehow made me happy too.
